policy: V29 registers MetaPay settlement-reversal/v2 and Financial OS reversal-accounting-decision/v2. Principal recovery, refund of a previously recognized settlement-fee expense, and any new reversal-processing fee are separate economic flows. Reversal never revives consumed distribution authorization.

additions.authority_note: Settlement reversal evidence only. Exact returned principal, separately evidenced original-fee refund, separately evidenced new processing fee; authorization remains consumed; no accounting/profit/execution authority.

Financial OS independently re-verifies v3 original settlement/accounting and MetaPay reversal v2. Principal recovery is EXTERNAL_CAPITAL/P&L-excluded; original-fee refund is a credit to external expense and restores realized P&L; new reversal-processing fee is a new EXTERNAL_EXPENSE.
